name: OMEGA 6 The Triangle Stars
original_name: オメガ６　ザ・トライアングルスターズ
source:
Future Earth.

Thanks to a technology that extends the average lifespan up to about 400 years, people refused to embrace the next generation and now live a life full of leisure.

One day, Earth saw an important migration of aliens and in the blink of an eye, all the major cities were occupied by aliens.

To help mankind prosper again, Victor Franglin, a leading expert in lifespan research, created two androids, Thunder and Kyla, and their spaceship Omega 6, to help him in his research and find a new Earth where humans can live.

They have been exploring space for more than 400 years for the planet of their dream, but to no avail, and this is how they ended up buying a whole planet.

Now heavily indebted, our two heroes work as bounty hunters and treasure hunters and their adventures to various planets are about to begin!
